description: Record one usage event for a project you own (owner credential, or that project's pt_ token). Every event needs a source-stable event_id, project_id, catalog tool_id, event_type (picked|rejected|tried|starred|purchased|feedback|used|not_useful|not_relevant|refunded|cancelled), observed_at (ISO date), evidence_level (user_reported|observed|assistant_inferred — vendor_verified is not client-assertable), and consent_version 2026-11-11-v1. Needs the usage_collection consent scope. A retry with the same event_id returns duplicate:1 and writes nothing twice. refunded/cancelled must name the earlier event in reverses_event_id and never edit history. Purchases recorded here are self-reported and never enter any verified-payment ledger.
name: record_decision
title: Record a usage event
